guideLine: <p>Print Guidelines</p><p>Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products.</p><p>Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc.</p><p>Download templates and mockups <a href="https://printway.larksuite.com/drive/folder/SXmMfdUEBlZWnYdopoluWd76sDZ">here</a></p><p>To use an Art Template:</p><p>Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.</p><p>Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.</p><p>If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.</p><p>Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.</p><p>Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.</p><p>You’ve now used a Printway template to create the artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.</p><p>To ensure your design prints properly on each product:</p><p>Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.</p><p>Fill out the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents the “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.</p><p>Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.</p>
